subject: Penetration report deliverables and remediation evidence — handoff plan
messages:
From: Julia Kemp <julia.kemp@acme-logistics.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-logistics.com, security@acme-logistics.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team completed an internal review and would like the full penetration test report you referenced, plus concrete evidence for remediation on the high/critical findings so we can map to our SOC 2 control workbook. Specifically, they asked for artifacts for:
- authentication hardening (mfa, session management)
- logging (sample logs showing the new events + retention path)
- secrets/key rotation (proof of rotation and updated keystore metadata)
- network ACL changes for the egress findings

Can you confirm: 1) you can share the PT report, 2) an ETA for the remediation artifacts above, and 3) whether any items are still in-flight that will require a follow-up? We’re hoping to close our SIG questionnaire by 2027-04-10 and need these artifacts attached to the submission.

Julia Kemp
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Logistics
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Julia Kemp <julia.kemp@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: aisha.rahman@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Hi Julia —

Appreciate the clarity. I’m looping in Aisha (solutions) and Aditya (ops/engineering lead) to confirm the exact ETA and package the artifacts. High-level: we can share the redacted PT report and produce a remediation evidence bundle. I will aim to get an initial delivery plan to you by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-02).

One question from our side: for the logging samples, do you need raw log files or sanitized screenshots / exports? We can provide both but want to align on what your auditors prefer.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Julia Kemp <julia.kemp@acme-logistics.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Vanessa / Julia —

Thanks for the handoff. Below is the remediation status and concrete ETA for each finding the Acme team listed. I’ll attach a remediation_manifest CSV in the delivery and include short notes on proof types.

1) Authentication hardening (high) — STATUS: implemented / verification in progress
   ETA for artifacts: 2027-04-04
   Proof: config diff from auth service, MFA enforcement logs, session timeout policy snippet, and screenshot of policy applied in the admin console.

2) Logging (critical) — STATUS: backlog item completed; long-term retention in work
   ETA for artifacts: 2027-04-05
   Proof: sanitized log export covering the exploit scenario (7-day sample), retention pipeline diagram, and a retained-object metadata CSV showing TTL set to 90 days.

3) Secrets / keystore rotation (high) — STATUS: rotation completed for service accounts; keystore rotation plan executed for the primary cluster
   ETA for artifacts: 2027-04-03 (proof available now)
   Proof: rotation manifest (keystore entries changed), timestamped audit entry (auth_rotation_proof.txt), and guidance on KMS usage.

4) Network egress ACL (medium) — STATUS: rule set updated and staged; scheduled deploy to prod this weekend
   ETA for artifacts: 2027-04-06
   Proof: ACL diff, firewall rule IDs, and deployment runbook excerpt.

Notes and constraints:
- We will redact customer IPs and internal hostnames in deliverables. If Acme needs a non-redacted set under an NDA, let us know and we’ll route to legal.
- The pen test report itself is ready for redacted distribution; full unredacted report requires a signed NDA between Acme and our security team.
- I’ll include a mapping sheet that ties each artifact to your SOC 2 / SIG control IDs.

Attachments in initial bundle: pen_test_report_Q1_2027.pdf (redacted), remediation_manifest_20270403.csv, auth_rotation_proof.txt. Full log exports and screenshots to follow by 2027-04-05.

If you need anything accelerated, flag which artifact you want prioritized and we’ll pull it forward.

- Aditya Rao
Engineering Manager, Platform Reliability
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Julia Kemp <julia.kemp@acme-logistics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-logistics.com, security@acme-logistics.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Aditya / Vanessa —

Thanks, this is very helpful. Two quick asks: 1) please include the exact control mapping (SOC 2 CC6, CC7 etc.) in the manifest so our compliance team can import it directly, and 2) can you provide the keystore rotation proof as a signed timestamp or log entry (we need verifiable rotation evidence for our auditors)?

If you can deliver the rotation proof and the redacted report by EOD Sunday (2027-04-04) that would be ideal — the rest can come in the following week. Also, we can sign an NDA for the unredacted report if required; procurement will send that separately.

Julia
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Julia Kemp <julia.kemp@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, aisha.rahman@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation evidence for SOC 2 mapping

Julia —

Confirming receipt and plan:
- We will publish the redacted PT report and the signed rotation proof by EOD Sunday 2027-04-04. The rotation proof will include a signed timestamp entry exported from our audit logs (auth_rotation_proof.txt).
- Remediation manifest will include a SOC 2 control mapping column (CC/Mapped Control) and a short summary for each artifact.
- Full log exports and ACL diffs will be delivered by 2027-04-06 as agreed.

I’ll drop the first bundle (redacted report + rotation proof + manifest) to the shared Drive link below and let you know when it’s ready. If procurement sends an NDA we’ll route the unredacted report to the secure folder.

Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/Acme-PT-Evidence-2027

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
